title: netstat itself is unavailable: both netstat judgements fail closed
titleZh: netstat 本身不可用:两处 netstat 判定都 fail-closed
why: defensive-spec 4.2 rules 1 and 3: a dead probe must produce unknown, never pass. This case covers the DSH-port judgement, the wildcard inventory and the serve judgement at once, so the same broken probe cannot produce a green security statement anywhere. The inventory half was a proven gap until the collector grew an explicit guard.
inject: both netstat snapshots removed from the fixture while native access is disabled (-NoNative)
expectSummary: DSH_LOOPBACK_ONLY, WILDCARD_LISTENER_INVENTORY and SERVE_PRESENT all unknown, exit != 0
